machine.nproc_note: GNU nproc honours OMP_NUM_THREADS, so `nproc` can print 1 on a multi-core host; `nproc_all` is the core count.
machine.thread_env_note: NPROC sizes XLA's CPU intra-op pool (the JAX rows); the BLAS knobs pin OpenBLAS/MKL/OpenMP (the numpy/scipy rows) and do not touch JAX. Two disjoint families; both are recorded on every CPU timing.

routes.fwd: jax.jacfwd(ll, has_aux=True), value as aux, one tangent per free parameter

protocol.argument: flat physical vector (jnp, model.prior_count entries); model.instance_from_vector(vector, xp=jnp) inside the trace (autofit JAX Fitness.call)

lanes.plain: PointFlux + FitPositionsSource (free source centre + flux, +3 params)

protocol.perturbation_prior: Gaussian mean 0.001, sigma 0.01 (not 0: the magnitude/angle parameterisation has a NaN gradient at exactly (0, 0))
protocol.instance_stream: entry 0 = prior medians; rest = vector_from_unit_vector(U(0.25,0.75)); batched stream = 16 fixed-seed batches of B draws from it
protocol.route_order: 4 executables round-robin, start rotated each round
protocol.gate_draws: prior medians + PRNGKey 0..15 U(0.25,0.75) unit draws
protocol.cache_trap_guard: fresh closure + fresh AnalysisPoint per executable; jax.clear_caches(); StableHLO hashes pairwise distinct per rung x lane
protocol.crossover: first upward crossing of ratio = 1, linear in n between bracketing rungs; interval = 5-95% of bootstrap-curve crossings (curve j = resample j of every rung)
protocol.solver: solver=None; FitPositionsSource never invokes a PointSolver
protocol.pytrees: autofit.jax.register_model(model) for every model before any trace
